item.description: Wendy Eisenberg at Le Poisson Rouge Mar. 25 | 6:30 PM | 16+ | $32.96 Wendy Eisenberg is a virtuoso guitarist. They can shred with the best of them. But Eisenberg is also a singer and songwriter, and while you may find them playing explosive free jazz improvisations, their solo shows are often drawn from Eisenberg’s recordings of songs, which draw on delicate folk, crunchy rock, and/or plaintive country music. item.title: The Westerlies at Roulette
item.description: The Westerlies at Roulette Mar. 26 | 7:00 PM | $25+ Bill Frisell recently turned 75. And while Wikipedia lists him as a jazz guitarist, anyone who knows Frisell knows that’s just a fraction of his work. He’s worked with rocker Elvis Costello, classical composer Gavin Bryars, country slide guitar hero Greg Leisz, Brazilian musician Vinicius Cantuaria, and dozens of others. item.description: Rafiq Bhatia at 92NY Mar. 27 | 7:30 PM | $20+ Rafiq Bhatia might be best known as a member of the trio Son Lux, the experimental electronic pop trio who were nominated for an Oscar for the score to Everything Everywhere All At Once.
